From posters, to organizers to boxes of stationery… you name it, I had it all 🧑🏼‍🩰Even throughout by bachelor days and at my Master’s dorm, my work desk was where the real magic happened, and I made sure I kept it equipped and decorated in the way that best fit my style, and my work-ways ⋰˚☆

Super blessed to be able to create (and get this organiser haha) with the folks at DO again 🫶🏽

1664136018471636.body:
Love has many ways of speaking. Some are said out loud. Some are painted, remembered, or simply felt. ❤️

In The Name Of Love is a collection by 70 year-old artist Kafeel Ahmed Ansari, who brings seven everyday expressions of love to life through his distinctive visual language. Rooted in the tradition of hand-painted Indian commercial art, his work draws from the world around him, from Bollywood cinema to the streets.

The collection is part of The Art. The Artist. The Object., a series where DailyObjects invites artists to give their work a life beyond the canvas, one that’s held, used and lived with every day.

Seven expressions. Countless ways to say it. 

Find yours in In The Name Of Love, now live on DailyObjects.com
